lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
“Grand Theft Auto VI” has gotten all kinds of attention since its release last week, The Associated Press reports.
Ontario Premier Doug Ford and Alberta Premier Danielle Smith expressed optimism Monday that Canada could see a trade deal reached with the U.S. before the end of the year, The Canadian Press reports.
Toronto Mayor Olivia Chow is using her strong mayor powers to replace the city’s top bureaucrat with an interim hire and shake up the city’s organizational structure, The Canadian Press reports.
Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO just days after rejecting his offer to return, Times Colonist reports.

Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a naval base in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Monday, claiming that sea drones sank the vessel in a surprise assault the previous day, The Associated Press reports.

President Donald Trump on Monday said he will defer to a federal appeals court on whether the administration moves ahead with plans to detonate several tons of degraded bomb-making material at an Iowa ammunition plant, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
